# Smart Agent Alliance

> > Smart Agent Alliance is an eXp Realty sponsorship and training platform led by Doug Smart and Karrie Hill, offering AI-powered agent education, revenue share guidance, and comprehensive brokerage comparison resources.

The site focuses on helping both new and experienced real estate agents navigate eXp Realty's unique cloud-based brokerage model, with emphasis on Mike Sherrard's AI Agent Accelerator training, revenue share opportunities, and strategic guidance for agent career development. Smart Agent Alliance provides detailed comparisons with traditional brokerages like Keller Williams, Coldwell Banker, and others while educating agents on 2026 industry trends including NAR settlement impacts.

## Key Topics

- eXp Realty sponsorship and mentorship
- Revenue share compensation models
- AI Agent Accelerator training by Mike Sherrard
- Commission splits and brokerage fees
- NAR settlement and 2026 industry changes
- Lead generation strategies
- Digital marketing for real estate agents
- Brokerage comparisons (Keller Williams, Coldwell Banker, Redfin, Fathom, Corcoran)
- New agent onboarding and licensing
- eXp cloud-based brokerage model
- Real estate agent training and education
- MLS and Zillow integration
- Social media marketing for agents
- Team leader compensation structures
- Agent career development
